_doc: Display-time glyph mapping ONLY (never applied to stored, searched, synced or hashed text). Empty since 2.0.0: the Quran text is KFGQPC Hafs v18 and is drawn with the Complex's own font (KFGQPC HAFS Uthmanic Script v18), which draws every code point of that text as published, so no substitution is needed. The end-of-ayah ornament is drawn by that font from Arabic-Indic digits.
